en: Target sighted! Let him have it!
Y'know, now that I'm seein' that meat,{SAUT}or weapon, or whatever it is again...{SAUT}That thing is freakin' huge.
I knew it. The more I see it, the stronger{SAUT}my curiosity and appetite become.
Oh man, is that fried chicken? That{SAUT}could feed, like, five―no―ten people!
Hey, hang on, guys. It's too dangerous{SAUT}to just charge in there alone.{PAGE}We're here too, so don't go takin' it all{SAUT}for yourselves, all right?
...You're right. We gotta divide it evenly.
I wasn't talking about the meat! I was{SAUT}saying don't take all the glory!
Haha. Yeah, I guess so...{PAGE}All right, let's bring this guy down!
